title: Sa Pa agreed to upgrade the app that should know the mountain
summary: On 13 October the Sa Pa ward and IGB Group agreed to hand over an upgraded Sa Pa Tour app, aimed at a digital map and more than one language. A download for visitors is not in the report.
when: Agreement on 13 October 2026. How a visitor opens it: Check on arrival.
photoAlt: A road and paddy fields near Sa Pa
body: Sa Pa would like an app that knows the terraces. On 13 October, at the ward office, the Sa Pa People’s Committee and IGB Group agreed to transfer two pieces of software, VietTimes reported. One is an upgrade of Sa Pa Tour, the smart-tourism programme carried over from when Sa Pa was a town. The other is a system for compensation and resettlement when the state recovers land, which is an office tool, not a guide. For the tourism app, the paper says the upgrade is meant to connect the ward, businesses, and visitors, to digitise destination information, and to add a digital map, more than one language, and tools that can use AI. Cao Bá Quý, chairman of the ward, said the point of the handover is practical use, not a slogan.

Do not look for a finished download in that story. The report does not name an app store, and it does not say the upgrade is already in a visitor’s hand. Check on arrival. The kiosks are in the same cautious state. The body of the piece says the two sides surveyed where a digital kiosk might go, for public procedures and tourism information. A caption says the ward inaugurated a digital kiosk. Both lines are in the same article. The photograph is the road and the paddies near town, which is the landscape an app would have to explain.
seoTitle: Sa Pa Tour app upgrade agreed on 13 October
seoDescription: On 13 October 2026 Sa Pa ward agreed to upgrade the Sa Pa Tour app with a digital map and multilingual information. No public download is confirmed.
